//: Tricked-out assaulter MRGG-A. No rename: it shares the base MRGG-A name. The kit is purely a function of the installed default_mods (all removable/swappable), so a player-built copy and this spawned one are identical.
description: A special operations configuration of the MRGG-A Assaulter, set up exactly the way a door-kicker would run it: a grippod up front, a holographic sight backed by a flip-to-side magnifier, a short suppressor, a weapon light and an aiming laser on the rails, and a sling.  Ready to fight straight out of the case.

//: Tricked-out sniper MRGG-S. No rename: shares the base MRGG-S name; the config is defined entirely by the removable default_mods.
description: A special operations configuration of the MRGG-S Sniper variant, kitted for precision work: a bipod, a high-end variable rifle scope, a full-size suppressor, an aiming laser, a tuned match trigger, and a sling.  Reach out and touch something.
